comparison.objective: Mount a thermometer clamp and install a thermometer into a beaker.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and position a clamp, tighten its screw knob, squeeze spring handles, and insert a fragile probe.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp is mounted, thermometer secured upright with tip immersed and scale visible.
comparison.reason: This assembly includes screw tightening but not adjustment preservation by a concentric jam nut or repeated motion retention.
